comment: Power menu for the S10+ (beyond2lte), installed to /etc/nuxel/power/power-menu.json. Single source of truth for the long-press POWER menu. The graphical Settings power surface (pwa/nuxel-apps/settings/power-menu.js), the console (nuxel-power-diag.sh menu) and the hardware-button FSM all read THIS table, so a finger tap and a console command can never disagree.

entries.label: Lock screen
entries.note: Screen off + lock; the display bridge stays the only framebuffer owner. Reversible by a POWER short press.

entries.label: Restart
entries.refusal_reason: gated — reboot-gate.json is closed because the owner is absent and no repository-side reboot policy has authorised a restart in this cycle. An ordinary reboot is permitted ONLY with a known-working userspace rollback path and the pre/post-reboot checklist.
entries.note: A restart must return to Nuxel. After three failed returns, stop rebooting and change diagnostic strategy.

entries.label: Power off
entries.refusal_reason: gated — powering the handset off with no owner present would strand the mission and cannot be undone remotely.

entries.label: Recovery
entries.refusal_reason: NO_FLASH_INVARIANT — entering Recovery means leaving Linux for the Samsung bootloader. This mission triggers no bootloader interface of any kind.
entries.note: The entry exists so the menu is honest about the device's capabilities; it is offline-tested as a REFUSAL and is never triggered by any automated path.

entries.label: Download Mode
entries.refusal_reason: NO_FLASH_INVARIANT — Download Mode exists only to flash, and this mission performs no flashing of any kind (no Heimdall/Odin/wrappers, no partition writes).
entries.note: Present for completeness and offline-tested as a refusal; never triggered.
